notes: Search input focus: `focus()` silently fails when called on `display: none` element: — the ref callback called `el.focus()` immediately on mount, but the discovery section was hidden at that point (`isDiscoveryOpen = false` → `hidden` class). Chromium/Electron silently discards `focus()` on `display: none` elements, so focus never reached the input. When the panel was later opened, a brief FOCUS event fired but was immediately stolen (BLUR to `<body>`). Fix: ref callback now only stores the ref (no focus logic); a dedicated `useEffect` with a 50ms delay waits for the CSS transition to make the element visible, then focuses and runs a persistent interval (100ms) that re-focuses the input whenever focus is lost, for as long as the discovery panel stays open.
